subject: Garland
text: Garland has 106 H.P., awards 250 Gold, and awards 130 Exp.

evidence.quote: Garland...H.P.: 106...Gold: 250...Exp.: 130

subject: Garland
text: Attack Garland with all characters, using Fire or Lit with a Black Mage or Red Mage and Cure with a White Mage if needed.

evidence.quote:
1) attack with every
character (except Black Mage/Red Mage who should use Fire/Lit to weaken
him), 2) White Mages can Cure someone if Garland gets lucky enough to land a
few hits on the same person

subject: Pirates
text: The Pirates encounter consists of nine enemies, each with 6 H.P., awarding 40 Gold and 40 Exp.

evidence.quote: Pirates...H.P.: 6...Gold: 40...Exp.: 40...NINE OF THE WEAKEST GUYS YOU CAN IMAGINE

subject: Pirates
text: Spread party attacks out to cut the Pirates down one by one without wasting hits.

evidence.quote: Spread your attacks out so the attacks will not be wasted, and just cut them down one by one.

subject: Wizards
text: Wizards have 84 H.P., award 300 Gold, and award 276 Exp.

evidence.quote: Wizards...H.P.: 84...Gold: 300...Exp.: 276

subject: Wizards
text: The party will face between two and four Wizards in the battle.

evidence.quote: You will have to face any amount of these tough guys from as two of them to as high as four of them.

subject: Wizards
text: Casting Lit2 with a Black Mage can potentially wipe out the entire Wizard group in a single turn.

evidence.quote: if you have a Black Mage, cast Lit2 as it can potentially wipe the entire Wizard party out in one shot.

subject: Astos
text: Astos has 168 H.P., awards 2000 Gold, and awards 2250 Exp.

subject: Astos
text: Astos can cast Rub for instant kills, Slow to halve hits, Fast to double his hits, and Fir2 against the entire party.

evidence.quote: He has Rub (one hit kills), Slow (halves your Hits total), Fast...total), and Fir2 (hurts your entire party)!

subject: Astos
text: Have physical attackers attack continuously while a Red Mage or Black Mage casts Fast on them and the White Mage heals as needed.

evidence.quote:
Have Fighter/Black Belt/Thief/ attack all of the time, have
Red Mage/Black Mage cast Fast on the physical attackers (gets them to land
more hits for more damage), and White Mage can attack unless some Cures are
needed.

subject: Earth
text: Earth has 288 H.P., awards 768 Gold, and awards 1536 Exp.

subject: Earth
text: Earth is weak to Fire, making Fir2 and Fir3 especially effective against it.

evidence.quote:
They do have one weakness, and that is to Fire, so Fir2 and Fir3 will really
damage them badly.

subject: Earth
text: Running from Earth battles is impossible, requiring all-out attacks to finish the fight quickly.

evidence.quote:
running from them is not an
option, so take them on with everything you got to end the fight quickly.

subject: Vampire
text: Vampire has 156 H.P., awards 2000 Gold, and awards 1200 Exp.

subject: Vampire
text: Vampire possesses decent attack power and can use the special ability Dazzle to stun party members.

evidence.quote:
He brings a decent attack power and his special ability called Dazzle (Stun)
to knock your party down for good!

subject: Vampire
text: Vampire is undead and highly vulnerable to Harm and Fire spells such as Fir2, Hrm2, Fir3, and Hrm3.

evidence.quote:
He is undead, so of course Harm and Fire
spells will clean his clock (one shot of Fir2, Hrm2, Fir3, or Hrm3 are often
enough to knock him down immediately!)!

subject: Lich
text: Lich, Fiend Of Earth, has 400 H.P., awards 3000 Gold, and awards 2200 Exp.

evidence.quote: Lich, Fiend Of Earth...H.P.: 400...Gold: 3000...Exp.: 2200

subject: Lich
text: Lich can land multiple physical hits that stun targets and casts spells including party-hitting Ice2 and Slep.

evidence.quote:
he does have a fairly good attack power (he can stun the person he attacks),
spells like Ice2 (hits your entire party) and Slep (can knock members out of
the fight for a while), and he can land multiple hits as well.

subject: Lich
text: Lich is classified as undead and takes massive damage from Fire and Harm spells such as Fir3 and Hrm3.

evidence.quote:
That being said, Lich is classified as undead, so Fire and harm spells will slaughter
his Hit points (therefore he can die from one blast each of Fir3 and Hrm3).

subject: Lich
text: Red Mages and Black Mages can cast Fast on physical attackers to defeat Lich with weapon attacks.

evidence.quote:
have your Red Mage and Black Mage cast Fast on the
weapon users to take him down physically

subject: Mud Gol
text: Mud Gol has 176 H.P., awards 800 Gold, and awards 1257 Exp.

subject: Mud Gol
text: Mud Gol deals high damage and can boost its attack power further by casting Fast.

evidence.quote:
They have a high damage stat, and that can be furthered by their special ability
of using Fast!

subject: Nitemare
text: Nitemare has 200 H.P., awards 700 Gold, and awards 1272 Exp.

evidence.quote: Nitemare...H.P.: 200...Gold: 700...Exp.: 1272

subject: Nitemare
text: Nitemare uses Snort to inflict Dark and is weak to Ice magic such as Ice2.

evidence.quote:
They are not particularly strong attacker, and their only special ability is
to Snort (Dark spell).  They have a weakness to Ice, so let them have it
with Ice2 while the rest of the party attacks, and you will quickly win this
fight!

subject: Zombie Dragon
text: Zombie Dragon has 268 H.P., awards 999 Gold, and awards 2331 Exp.

evidence.quote: Zombie Dragon...H.P.: 268...Gold: 999...Exp.: 2331

subject: Zombie Dragon
text: Zombie Dragon has high attack power with a stun effect and is weak to Fire and Harm spells due to being undead.

evidence.quote:
undead Dragons that have a high attack power (they can also stun your characters with their attack)!  Since they
are undead, Fire and harm spells will just decimate them

subject: Mage
text: Mage has 105 H.P., awards 1095 Gold, and awards 1095 Exp.

subject: Mage
text: Mages appear in groups of 1 to 4 and cast dangerous spells including Fir2, Lit2, Ice2, Rub, and Stun.

evidence.quote:
These guys will show up in any number from 1 to 4, and they are incredibly
dangerous with their attack spells (Fir2, Lit2, Ice2, Rub, Stun).

subject: Blizzard Dragon
text: Blizzard Dragon has 200 H.P., awards 1701 Gold, and awards 2000 Exp.

evidence.quote: Blizzard Dragon...H.P.: 200...Gold: 1701...Exp.: 2000

subject: Blizzard Dragon
text: Blizzard Dragon uses strong physical attacks and the special attack Blizzard, but is susceptible to Fire spells like Fir2.

evidence.quote:
very strong physical attacks and a special attack called Blizzard (something
like Ice2 or Ice3).  They are susceptible to Fire as you might imagine, so
lay at least a Fir2 into them

subject: Eye
text: Eye has 162 H.P., awards 3225 Gold, and awards 3225 Exp.

subject: Eye
text: Eye casts instant-kill spells including Rub, Stone, and XXXX, but has weak physical defense and can be neutralized with Mute.

evidence.quote:
the Eye is very big on one-hit kills (Rub, Stone,
XXXX).  However, with a weak defense, weapons can cut this evil entity down
quickly.  As for Magic, hard hitting magic spells are a gamble, Mute is a
great move (stop the spells, no danger from his enemy).

subject: Fire
text: Fire has 276 H.P., awards 800 Gold, and awards 1620 Exp.

subject: Fire
text: Defeat Fire by attacking with physical weapons and casting Ice2 or Ice3 using a Red Wizard or Black Wizard.

evidence.quote:
have your team attack with weapons, have your Red
Wizard or Black Wizard attack with Ice2 or Ice3, and have your White Wizard
or Red Wizard perform healing duties as needed.

subject: Red Dragon
text: Red Dragon has 248 H.P., awards 4000 Gold, and awards 2904 Exp.

evidence.quote: Red Dragon...H.P.: 248...Gold: 4000...Exp.: 2904

subject: Red Dragon
text: Red Dragon inflicts up to 300 Hit Points with Blaze and over 100 Hit Points physically, and is vulnerable to Ice.

evidence.quote:
He
can use his special attack of Blaze (Fir3 is the equivalent) to damage each
party member for up to 300 Hit Points each, AND he can also attack with
ferocity (often inflicting 100 Hit Points or more damage).  This beast is
vulnerable to Ice, but you may have run out of charges for it by now, so use
Fir3 or Lit3 from a Black Wizard instead.

subject: Kary
text: Kary, Fiend Of Fire, has 600 H.P., awards 5000 Gold, and awards 4245 Exp.

evidence.quote: Kary, Fiend Of Fire...H.P.: 600...Gold: 5000...Exp.: 4245

subject: Kary
text: Kary can land multiple physical hits, inflict stun, and cast Fir2 against the party.

evidence.quote:
Kary has a decent attack power and the ability to throw multiple hits at her
targets.  That being said, her true power lies in her use of Fir2 and her
ability to stun your party members.

subject: Kary
text: To defeat Kary, have Knights and Masters attack while mages cast Fast on weapon users and the White Wizard uses Inv2 and Cure.

evidence.quote:
Knight and Master attack, Red
Wizard, Ninja, and Black Wizard use Fast on the proficient weaponry users
(even themselves if necessary), and White Wizard will use Inv2 and then Cure
any ailing allies.

subject: Kraken
text: Kraken, Fiend Of Water, has 800 H.P., awards 5000 Gold, and awards 4245 Exp.

evidence.quote: Kraken, Fiend Of Water...H.P.: 800...Gold: 5000...Exp.: 4245

subject: Kraken
text: Kraken uses Ink to inflict Dark and can strike up to 8 Hits in one turn dealing over 100 Hit Points of damage.

evidence.quote:
He does have on attack that is essentially a waste of a
turn (Ink, which is a Dark spell), but he can land up to 8 Hits at a time,
allowing him to deal well over 100 Hit Points of Damage!

subject: Kraken
text: Cast Fast and Inv2 before attacking Kraken with physical strikes and casting Lit2 and Lit3 spells.

evidence.quote:
have your Red Wizard/Black Wizard/Ninja cast Fast on hard hitters like
Knights/Masters/Ninjas, have your White Wizard cast Inv2 (may allow your
characters to dodge an attack from Kraken), and have your attackers throw
their best shots at the fiend.  After you have Fasted everyone, start
throwing Lit2 and Lit3 spells at Kraken

subject: Blue Dragon
text: Blue Dragon has 454 HP, awards 2000 Gold, and awards 3274 Exp.

evidence.quote: Blue Dragon...HP: 454...Gold: 2000...Exp: 3274

subject: Blue Dragon
text: Blue Dragon uses the party-wide Thunder attack and has an elemental weakness to Fire spells like Fir3.

evidence.quote:
This is a big, bad, and mad dragon that can hit hard and has a hit all
attack called Thunder!...The Blue Dragon also has an elemental weakness to Fire, so a Red
Wizard/Black Wizard Fir3 would be ideal as well for dealing large amounts of
damage.

subject: Mage Staff
text: A White Wizard can use the Mage Staff in combat against the Blue Dragon to cast Fir2.

evidence.quote:
If you have a White Wizard, they will have to be on healing duty,
possibly using the Mage Staff in battle for a shot of Fir2 to help out.

subject: WarMech
text: WarMech, The Walking Death Dealer, has 1000 H.P., awards 32000 Gold, and awards 32000 Exp.

evidence.quote: WarMech, The Walking Death Dealer...H.P.: 1000...Gold: 32000...Exp.: 32000

subject: WarMech
text: WarMech has a Damage stat of 128-256 and casts Nuclear to inflict up to 400 Hit Points of damage to the entire party.

evidence.quote:
sporting an insanely strong Damage stat
(128-256) as well as a hit-all attack in Nuclear (deals up to 400 Hit Points
of damage!).

subject: WarMech
text: Cast Afir to reduce damage from Nuclear, cast Inv2 to evade physical attacks, and use Fast on physical attackers against WarMech.

evidence.quote:
using Afir immediately to help lessen the damage dealt
by Nuke (try INv2 as well to possibly avoid a physical attack altogether).
For taking him down, Knights and Masters tackle him physically (Ninjas too),
Ninjas/Black Wizard/Red Wizard cast Fast on the hard hitting attackers, and
White Wizard should use high end heal/Cure spells to keep everyone in the
fight.

subject: Tiamat
text: Tiamat, Fiend Of Air, has 1000 H.P., awards 6000 Gold, and awards 5496 Exp.

evidence.quote: Tiamat, Fiend Of Air...H.P.: 1000...Gold: 6000...Exp.: 5496

subject: Tiamat
text: Tiamat lands multiple physical hits and uses party-wide attacks including Thunder, Blizzard, and Poison.

evidence.quote:
He does boast...moderately powerful Damage stat (able
to land numerous hits as well), and he does make use of Thunder, Blizzard,
and Poison as a hit-all attack.

subject: Tiamat
text: Tiamat has a glaring weakness to Bane, which can be cast by a Red Wizard, Black Wizard, or through using the Bane Sword.

evidence.quote:
That being said, he does hold a very
glaring weakness to Bane, so if your Red Wizard/Black Wizard can cast it,
they might try it (someone using the Bane Sword can make an extra attempt
with the spell if they can not cast it regularly).

subject: Tiamat
text: Conventional tactics against Tiamat involve casting Fast on physical attackers, using Nuke, and casting Alit, Aice, Inv2, and Cure.

evidence.quote:
Knight and Master attack, Ninja/Red Wizard/Black Wizard cast Fast on first
round, attack on the second (you may want to use Nuke if possible), and
your White Wizard is on Cure detail as well as some Alit, Aice and/or Inv2.
